description: Maps of NSW main roads is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NSW Government. This document contains maps of roads identified as State Road or part Regional Road, under the administrative agreements with Local Government. These roads are also legally classified as Freeway, Tollway, State Highway, Main Road or Tourist Road under the Roads Act 1993. A summary listing is also included. Coverage: NSW Government. The portal files it under the publisher NSW Government. Its tags are Roads and Traffic Authority of New South Wales. It offers 1 resource(s) in PDF. The portal shows 2026-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is licence code "lsba" on the portal (not expanded on the listing). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
